title: summary (run closure)
description: Written once when a run ends, however it ends. An honest abort recorded here is worth more than a success that was really a turn-cap in disguise.

termination_reason.description: mutual_pass is the only success, and needs the matrix GREEN on the latest turn as well as the Critic and Builder passes. The other four are honest aborts and must be reported as such, never dressed up.

contract_hashes.description: unit id -> canonical hash at lock time. Later stages re-check this before trusting a contract.
